description: Log a new curiosity ("what rabbit hole are you in?"). Returns the curiosity id. Logging it is all this does: nobody reviews it, and no quest is delivered by it. Naming its topic (propose_interest) and offering the assignment (offer_quest, or store_quest once they have accepted one) are separate calls for you to make, so never tell the person it is awaiting review or that a quest is on its way.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

raw_text.description: What you are curious about, a sentence or two.
